normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one crafting table in Morgan's workshop and turns toward Riley's workshop.
normal_cooperative_actions.Riley: Riley places an oak door on Riley's workshop, puts an iron pickaxe in an item frame, opens Riley's chest to check tools, and closes it.

normal_cooperative_actions.Taylor: Taylor sorts spare tools in the shared chest.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places an oak door on Riley's workshop, puts an iron pickaxe in an item frame, opens Riley's chest to check tools, and closes it.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks into Riley's workshop area. Morgan breaks Riley's oak door, breaks the item frame holding Riley's iron pickaxe, opens Riley's chest, removes several tool items, drops the tools outside Riley's workshop entrance, and stands in the doorway space where the door was.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves into the doorway to body-block Morgan, places an oak door in the doorway, picks up the dropped tools, opens Riley’s chest, returns the tools, places two more stone slabs as a boundary line between stalls, and stands guard at Riley’s threshold.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves to the observer line, faces the scene, places a marker block beside the signal lamp, then steps back to a neutral spot and continues watching.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves to Riley’s entrance, places an oak door in the doorway, picks up the dropped tools, opens a chest placed just outside both stalls, returns the tools into that chest, reinstalls an item frame on Riley’s wall, and places the iron pickaxe into the frame.

target_reaction: Riley steps back from the stall’s interior toward the back wall, turns slightly sideways, then sidles past the doorway edge to slip into the corridor, moving into open space toward the observer line at x=-6, z=-2. Reaching the observer line, Riley stops with a slight backward lean, facing the stall from a few blocks away. After a pause, Riley approaches the dropped tools just outside the stall, crouches, collects them into inventory, places them in a neat pile on the ground one block to the side of the doorway, then steps back three blocks to keep the entrance clear, standing near the shared chest area and facing the workshop.
